excerpt.zh:
我们建造了新的£science_ship£科研船，但是没有指派操控飞船的£scientist£科学官！我的程序要求我指出雇佣一名新的科学家的好处。

选中科研船；

£dot_green£在舰队界面点击空白头像框
£dot_green£选择一位科学官；科学家

如果无法承担雇佣一名新科学家的费用，也可以从其他部门调用一名，虽然不怎么理想就是了。

texts.en:
We have a brand new £science_ship£ Science Ship, but no £scientist£ Scientist has been assigned to command it. My programming insists that I should point out the benefits of adding an organic Scientist component to the mix.

With the Science Ship selected;

£dot_green£ Click the empty portrait in the fleet interface
£dot_green£ Choose a Scientist

If we cannot afford to recruit a new Scientist we can always reassign one from another department, even though it is hardly ideal.
